name: (04) Protean — 2 Intermediate — Shape of the Beast

system.description:
The old tales are true: you shift your undead body into the form of a beast — most often a wolf or a bat, though jackals, dingoes and giant rats have all been reported.

Shifting costs one Blood Trait and takes three full turns; each additional Blood Trait spent lowers the time by one turn, to a minimum of one turn at three Traits. Clothing and small possessions change with you, and you remain in beast form until the next dawn or until you choose to change back. You retain all your Disciplines except Necromancy, Serpentis, Thaumaturgy and Vicissitude. Wolf form grants the bonus Mental Traits Alert and Attentive, the effect of Feral Claws and improved running speed; bat form grants flight and the benefits of Acute Hearing but a maximum of three Physical Traits. Retest with Survival.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next dawn or you choose to revert
